title: Cueless EEG imagined speech for subject identification: dataset and benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2501.09700v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals have emerged as a promising modality for biometric identification. While previous studies have explored the use of imagined speech with semantically meaningful words for subject identification, most have relied on additional visual or auditory cues. In this study, we introduce a cueless EEG-based imagined speech paradigm, where subjects imagine the pronunciation of semantically meaningful words without any external cues. This innovative approach addresses the limitations of prior methods by requiring subjects to select and imagine words from a predefined list naturally. The dataset comprises over 4,350 trials from 11 subjects across five sessions. We assess a variety of classification methods, including traditional machine learning techniques such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and XGBoost, as well as time-series foundation models and deep learning architectures specifically designed for EEG

translated_title: 无提示脑电想象言语用于个体识别：数据集与基准测试
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）信号已成为生物识别中一种有前景的模态。尽管以往研究探索了使用具有语义意义的词语进行想象言语来实现个体识别，但大多数方法依赖于额外的视觉或听觉提示。在本研究中，我们引入了一种基于脑电的无提示想象言语范式，受试者在没有任何外部提示的情况下想象发音具有语义意义的词语。这种创新方法通过要求受试者自然地从一个预定义列表中选择并想象词语，解决了先前方法的局限性。该数据集包含来自11名受试者、五个会话的超过4350次试验。我们评估了多种分类方法，包括支持向量机（SVM）和XGBoost等传统机器学习技术，以及专门为脑电设计的时间序列基础模型和深度学习架构。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需外部提示的脑电想象言语范式，用于个体识别，并构建了包含4350次试验的多会话数据集及多种分类方法的基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a cueless EEG-based imagined speech paradigm for subject identification, constructing a multi-session dataset of over 4,350 trials and benchmarking various classification methods.
